Name: Beat Sophia bluemoon wine
Author: paun405
Description:
*** you should back up your SVE mod files first ***


you can also edit the blue moon wine price instead of breaking the ancient fruit price

go to common\Stardew Valley\Mods\Stardew Valley Expanded\[JA] Stardew Valley Expanded\Objects\Blue Moon Wine  ---> this will adjust blue moon wine price in Gus store


go to common\Stardew Valley\Mods\Stardew Valley Expanded\[TMX] Stardew Valley Expanded\content  ---> then ctrl + f  and type blue moon wine this will adjust blue moon wine and aged blue moon wine price in Sophia ledger

Manifest.Name: (CP) Beat Sophia Wine
Manifest.Description: Adjust the Ancient fruit price to beat bluemoon wine.
Manifest.Author: P199Y
